instruction: Quote-format retry. In every quote_checks entry, select the exact citation_id you intend to evaluate. Return @FULL_CITED_EXCERPT@ for its quote to reference that citation's entire unchanged supplied excerpt. Read the excerpt and evaluate the exact hypothesis as usual. Select only relevant citations. Leave the array empty when there is no applicable citation. Referencing a whole excerpt does not establish entailment. Explain the decisive detail or missing qualification in reason. All other rubric and citation ownership rules apply.
